key.name: theme
key.summary: Theme: "system" follows org.gnome.desktop.interface color-scheme (pref_theme)

key.name: pure-black
key.summary: Pure black night mode: a black window and Etar's _black colours, when the theme is dark

key.name: real-event-colors
key.summary: Use real event colors (else Etar's darker, more saturated ones)

key.name: view
key.summary: The view shown last (day, week, month, agenda): KEY_START_VIEW

key.name: default-view
key.summary: Default view: "previous" (Previously used view), day, week, month or agenda

key.name: month-lines-portrait
key.summary: Display options, Month view (portrait): max number of lines in an event

key.name: month-time-portrait
key.summary: Display options, Month view (portrait): 0 no time (a phone's default, show_time_in_month false), 1 start, 2 start and end, 4 start and end below (a tablet's)

key.name: month-location-portrait
key.summary: Display options, Month view (portrait): display location

key.name: month-lines-landscape
key.summary: Display options, Month view (landscape): max number of lines in an event

key.name: month-time-landscape
key.summary: Display options, Month view (landscape): as month-time-portrait

key.name: month-location-landscape
key.summary: Display options, Month view (landscape): display location

key.name: hide-declined
key.summary: Hide declined events: events this calendar's owner declined (ATTENDEE PARTSTAT=DECLINED)

key.name: staggered
key.summary: Staggered display: overlapping events in a staggered layout

key.name: show-week-number
key.summary: Show week number (the Week and Day views' subtitle, the Month view's column)

key.name: week-start
key.summary: Week starts on: -1 the locale's, 1 Sunday … 7 Saturday (preferences_week_start_day)

key.name: days-per-week
key.summary: Days per week: the days the Week view shows

key.name: default-event-duration
key.summary: Default event duration, minutes

key.name: home-tz-enabled
key.summary: Use home time zone: the app shows times in home-tz instead of the phone's zone

key.name: home-tz
key.summary: Home time zone (an IANA zone id); empty: the phone's zone at the time it was turned on

key.name: recent-timezones
key.summary: The time zones chosen last in the time zone picker, oldest first, at most 3 (preferences_recent_timezones)

key.name: search-history
key.summary: The searches made, newest first (SearchRecentSuggestions); "Clear search history" empties it

key.name: notifications
key.summary: Notifications: the reminder service notifies for reminders

key.name: reminder-sound
key.summary: Sound of a reminder: "default" (the sound theme's message-new-instant), "" silent, or a sound file's path

key.name: reminder-vibrate
key.summary: Vibration with a reminder (feedbackd), on a phone with a vibrator

key.name: popup
key.summary: Pop-up notification: a reminder also opens the app's reminders screen (AlertActivity)

key.name: custom-snooze
key.summary: Ask for reminder snooze delay: Snooze asks how long (SnoozeDelayActivity)

key.name: default-snooze
key.summary: Default snooze delay time, minutes; -1 no Snooze

key.name: default-reminder
key.summary: Default reminder time of a new event, minutes; -1 none

key.name: quick-responses
key.default: ["Running just a couple of minutes late.", "Be there in about 10 minutes.", "Go ahead and start without me.", "Sorry, I can't make it. We'll have to reschedule."]
key.summary: Quick responses: the canned texts of "Email guests"

key.name: skip-reminders
key.summary: Skip reminders (Experimental): "declined", "not_responded" (declined or not responded), "" none

key.name: cell-height
key.summary: The day and week views' hour height in dp, as pinched (DayView's mCellHeight)

key.name: last-calendar
key.summary: The calendar the last new event went to (the next new one goes there too)
